profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Java/Spring, AWS, K8s, PL/SQL
profile.summary:
As a software engineer at Nationwide, I work with a variety of tools to develop and deploy software solutions that meet the needs of the insurance industry. I am a lifelong learner, always seeking new challenges and skills to enhance both my personal and professional growth.

I am passionate about making software work well, using analysis, automation and process refinement to improve quality and efficiency. I try to always have a team-first mentality, and believe that it is vital to support my colleagues with the right tools and opportunities for their own success.
